title: Teachers can print the field check on one page
items: Guide has a new For teachers section. Print the handout gives one sheet, Letter or A4, with the field check's seven steps as students will see them.
Under the steps are three suggested Jaunts for each destination: the featured ones first, then the shortest. 1812 says it has no Jaunts yet.
You can also read the handout in Guide before you print it.
